CompleteReviewRequest.description: A child answer; the server derives correctness from the source question.
CompleteReviewRequest.title: CompleteReviewRequest

CompletedWorksheetConfirmation.description: The durable learning records created from a parent-confirmed scan.
CompletedWorksheetConfirmation.title: CompletedWorksheetConfirmation

CompletedWorksheetResponseInput.description: One reviewed answer region from an already-completed paper.
CompletedWorksheetResponseInput.title: CompletedWorksheetResponseInput

ConfirmCompletedWorksheetRequest.description: The parent's reviewed extraction; answers stay attached to the scan.
ConfirmCompletedWorksheetRequest.title: ConfirmCompletedWorksheetRequest

CreateCompletedWorksheetRequest.description: A parent-uploaded paper that already contains a child's answers.
CreateCompletedWorksheetRequest.title: CreateCompletedWorksheetRequest

FamilyCompletedWorksheetImport.description: Safe parent-facing summary used to recover an unfinished paper review.
FamilyCompletedWorksheetImport.title: FamilyCompletedWorksheetImport

FigureConfig.description:
Private image configuration attached to a question by its parent.

The object path remains server-side. Active child attempts receive only a
short-lived URL, so a worksheet image cannot be reused outside its family.
FigureConfig.title: FigureConfig

FigureInput.description:
A parent-attached private image used by a single question.

AI JSON never needs to invent a storage path. The review screen adds this
field only after a parent selects an image from their device.
FigureInput.title: FigureInput

LibraryReviewSubmission.description: Reviewer-safe metadata; never includes sources, answers, or child work.
LibraryReviewSubmission.title: LibraryReviewSubmission

ListeningConfig.description:
Private configuration saved with a listening question.

The storage path and transcript never travel in the default child question
shape. Repositories explicitly create a signed, short-lived view for an
active attempt instead.
ListeningConfig.title: ListeningConfig

ListeningInput.description:
Audio details added by the parent browser after JSON preview.

AI-produced JSON intentionally has no private storage paths. The parent
selects an audio file during review, and the browser inserts its private
path before final import.
ListeningInput.title: ListeningInput

ListeningQuestionView.description:
The safe, child-facing subset of a listening question.

Audio URLs are absent until the child deliberately starts a permitted
playback. This prevents a work payload from becoming a reusable media URL.
ListeningQuestionView.title: ListeningQuestionView

ParentHistoryItem.description: Parent-only history metadata; never returned by the child history route.
ParentHistoryItem.title: ParentHistoryItem

PublicLibraryCopy.description: A new family-owned question set copied from an immutable revision.
PublicLibraryCopy.title: PublicLibraryCopy

PublicLibraryItem.description: Anonymous metadata for a published, reusable question set.
PublicLibraryItem.title: PublicLibraryItem

ResponseRevision.description:
A privacy-preserving record of a photo-answer change.

The timeline deliberately contains no object path, filename, signed URL,
or image metadata. The parent's current-answer preview is the only place
that can expose a currently attached private image.
ResponseRevision.title: ResponseRevision

ReviewLibrarySubmissionRequest.description: An explicit, auditable decision by a configured library reviewer.
ReviewLibrarySubmissionRequest.title: ReviewLibrarySubmissionRequest
